label: incomplete
criteria: Retry on 401 with stored password: When the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 and an admin password is stored, the command SHALL mint a new token, store it in the keyring, and retry the request once.

Error on 401 without password: When the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 and no admin password is stored, the command SHALL stop with one error line that names `argocd.token` and the credential sync command.
Error on retry 401: When the retried request after minting a new token also returns HTTP 401, the command SHALL stop with one error line.
Error on other HTTP status: When the Argo CD API returns any HTTP status other than 401, the command SHALL stop with one error line containing the status code.
Error is DevOpsCLIError: Every Argo CD API error SHALL be raised as a `DevOpsCLIError` subclass so the exit seam reports it.
note: The plan covers only three commands. Two other Argo CD API callers use the same stored token with a raw `raise_for_status` and have the same traceback: `fleet.py` (used by fleet and sync commands) and `gitops.py`. The plan does not name them as out of scope or as a follow-up. The design says 'duplicating ... across four or more commands', and the issue title says 'each argo API command', yet only three are changed. After the change, `devops argo sync` and the gitops sync still end in a traceback on a refused token.
